item.title: FlyDubai Pilot Recounts Survival in Call With Indian Leader
item.description: The FlyDubai captain attacked by his co-pilot described his survival in an emotional video call with India's leader from his hospital bed.

item.title: September jobs report to indicate hiring resilience
item.description: The report offers an economic measure as inflation remains elevated.

item.title: Hegseth establishes Pentagon religious affairs office under his direction
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is creating a religious affairs office at the Pentagon.

item.title: DOE employee arrested for alleged support of Yemen's Houthis
item.description: A Department of Energy electrical engineer faces charges of aiding Iranian-backed Houthi rebels.
